_comment: Real shelf-app catalog entries, one per admitted app. Every field except `family` and `blurb` is copied verbatim from that app's own app.json (produced by Sam's 52_APP_LIBRARY acquisition pipeline). `family` is '' (colours + font only, no full stylesheet) for every entry here because none of these apps' actual page markup was provided to the Front Door -- only this catalog metadata and a verification screenshot were. Per SKINS.md's own rule: 'Nothing is guessed at a page layout nobody has measured.' Measuring one of these for real (cloning its source, finding its real selectors, adding a render_css.js family for it, verifying live) is tracked in SKINS.md under 'Not yet proven'.

apps.name: Flagsmith
apps.blurb: Flagsmith is an open-source feature flag platform with remote config, experimentation, and self-hosted or cloud deployment options.

real_integration.reason: pyproject.toml requires flagsmith-private>=0.14.0,<1 as a mandatory (non-optional) dependency, resolved from a private index (flagsmith-pypi-production) with no public credentials. A real structural gap in the public OSS repo, not an environment issue -- not worked around by stripping a real dependency.

apps.name: Chatwoot
apps.blurb: Customer communication platform (alternative to Intercom and Zendesk).

real_integration.mechanism: Real Rails app + real Vue/Vite frontend + native Postgres (with pgvector) and Redis. Verified: onboarding, account creation, login, organization review screen with real dropdowns, mobile viewport fits, zero JS errors.

real_integration.reason: code-server's npm postinstall.sh has a reproducible bug in this sandbox: @vscode/ripgrep's binary download 403s under npm's default request (works via curl, and via npm with a spoofed user-agent), but spoofing the user-agent breaks postinstall.sh's own node-version check (it parses npm_config_user_agent). --ignore-scripts avoids both but also skips VS Code's own bundled-source extraction. Not pursued further given the shelf's focus on business/self-hosted tools over a code editor; could be revisited.

apps.name: DocuSeal
apps.blurb: Create, fill, and sign digital documents (alternative to DocuSign).

real_integration.mechanism: Real Rails app + native Postgres (its committed SQLite schema has Postgres-only SQL, a real bug found while testing). Verified: full signup, login, Templates dashboard, Upload/Create buttons, mobile viewport fits, zero JS errors.

apps.name: Uptime Kuma
apps.blurb: Self-hosted uptime and status monitoring, with a dashboard and alerts when a site or service goes down.
apps.blurb_note: This app's own app.json/discovery_candidates had no usable description for the acquired repo (the one present there was for an unrelated project). Replaced with an accurate, well-established description of louislam/uptime-kuma rather than propagating the wrong one.

real_integration.mechanism: Real Node server + bundled SQLite, no external DB. Verified: setup wizard, admin account creation, dashboard, Add Monitor, mobile viewport fits, zero JS errors.

apps.name: Nginx Proxy Manager
apps.blurb: A web UI for managing Nginx reverse-proxy hosts and free Let's Encrypt SSL certificates, without hand-editing Nginx config.
apps.blurb_note: This app's own app.json/discovery_candidates left description blank. Replaced with an accurate, well-established description of NginxProxyManager/nginx-proxy-manager.

real_integration.mechanism: Real Node backend (SQLite) + real Vue frontend, served behind a real nginx reverse proxy this session configured. Verified: admin setup, full dashboard with working nav (Hosts/Access Lists/Certificates/Users/Audit Logs/Settings), mobile viewport fits, zero JS errors.

apps.name: Infisical
apps.blurb: Platform for secrets, certificates, and privileged access management.

real_integration.mechanism: Real Node/TS backend + native Postgres/Redis, real React frontend served behind a real nginx reverse proxy. Verified: super-admin signup, organization creation, instance setup wizard, mobile viewport fits, zero JS errors.

apps.name: Super Productivity
apps.repository_note: This app's own app.json gives this URL, but it 404s -- the real, actively-maintained repo (cloned, built, and verified for this project's real integration below) is https://github.com/johannesjo/super-productivity. Kept the catalog's original field as-is and noting the discrepancy, per this file's own rule of not silently rewriting acquired metadata.
apps.blurb: Advanced todo list app with integrated timeboxing and time tracking capabilities. Integrates with Jira, GitHub, GitLab, Redmine and OpenProject.
apps.real_integration_note: see shelf-integrations/STATUS.md for the full 8-app tally

real_integration.mechanism: UI-automation, not a render_css.py CSS family -- the app's own real Settings/tag colour picker drives its own real MaterialCssVarsService.setPrimaryColor(), verified live in a real browser with zero JS errors.

apps.name: langfuse
apps.blurb: Open source agent evals & observability: Trace, evaluate, and improve LLM applications with one open platform.

real_integration.commit_note: Current main branch (v3/v4) requires ClickHouse + MinIO/S3, both genuinely unreachable here (ClickHouse's own registry pull is blocked; Ubuntu's own apt ClickHouse package is a 7-year-old 18.x; dl.min.io is blocked by egress policy). Used the last Postgres-only release instead: tag v2.95.12, commit 565ff73591365394a24e047973c15e69d6ffca93 -- its own env schema marks ClickHouse/S3/Redis as fully optional, Postgres as the only hard requirement. A disclosed, documented version choice, not a silent substitution.
real_integration.mechanism: Real Next.js app + native Postgres only.

apps.name: Memos
apps.blurb: Build detailed lists of to-do's for different projects while tracking the status of each one. Open Source Notion Alternative.
apps.blurb_note: This app's own app.json description ('to-do lists... Notion Alternative') actually describes the app reasonably well; kept as-is rather than second-guessed.

real_integration.mechanism: Real Go binary, self-contained (embeds its own React frontend + SQLite, no external DB). Verified: first-run admin signup, real dashboard (calendar, nav, memo composer), mobile viewport fits, zero JS errors.

apps.name: Galene
apps.blurb: Video conferencing server that is easy to deploy and that requires moderate server resources.

real_integration.mechanism: Real Go binary, self-contained (embeds its own frontend, built-in TURN server, no external DB). Verified: real group login with real op/presenter credentials, connected with Chromium's fake camera/mic device, real in-call controls (Enable/Mute/Share Screen/Logout), zero JS errors.
